name: Ticket Status Definitions
description: Definitions and lifecycle of ticket statuses in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus
content:
Ticket Status Lifecycle:
- Open: Newly created ticket, not yet assigned or acknowledged
- Assigned: Ticket has been assigned to a technician but work has not started
- In Progress: Technician is actively working on the ticket
- Waiting for Customer: Technician needs information from the requester
- Waiting for Vendor: Waiting on a third-party vendor for resolution
- Waiting for parts - NOC: Waiting on NOC team for parts or infrastructure
- Part Required: Physical parts are needed to resolve the issue
- Onhold: Ticket is temporarily paused
- Closed: Ticket has been resolved and closed
- Cancelled: Ticket was cancelled before resolution

Key Notes:
- A ticket is considered 'resolved' when status is 'Closed'
- Active/open tickets include: Open, Assigned, In Progress, Waiting for Customer, Waiting for Vendor, Part Required, Waiting for parts - NOC
- 'Onhold' tickets should generally be excluded from SLA calculations
- 'Cancelled' tickets should be excluded from resolution metrics
